# Skill: asb-dev-stack

Thin wrapper: the rules for this stack live in the domain packs below.
This skill only documents the commands.

## Canonical Instructions

1. Read [`docs/domains/server/`](../../../docs/domains/server/README.md)
   and [`docs/domains/web/`](../../../docs/domains/web/README.md) before
   changing anything under `server/` or `web/` — package layout, the
   error model, authentication, and testing conventions live there, not
   here.
2. Use the dev loop below while iterating.
3. Before committing, run the full check sequence below — it is the same
   sequence CI runs.

## Dev loop

Two processes, in two terminals, both from the repository root unless
noted:

```bash
# Terminal 1 — the daemon, in dev mode (accepts the Vite origin)
uv run asb-server serve --dev

# Terminal 2 — Vite, from web/ (proxies /api to the daemon)
cd web && pnpm dev
```

Vite serves on `http://localhost:5173`; `/api` is proxied to the daemon
on `127.0.0.1:7420`. Open `asb-agent ui --print-url` for a token URL
without starting a browser, or run the daemon with
`--fixture server/fixtures/healthy-tree.json` (path resolved against the
daemon's own working directory) to develop against fixed data without
Podman, Git or SSH.

## Full check sequence (what CI runs)

Python, from the repository root:

```bash
uv sync --frozen
uv run ruff check server
uv run pytest tests/unit server/tests
node scripts/sync-skills.mjs --check
```

Web, from `web/`:

```bash
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm check:api
pnpm lint
pnpm test
pnpm build
pnpm exec playwright install chromium
pnpm test:e2e
```

`pnpm check:api` needs `uv` on `PATH` — it shells out to
`asb-server openapi`. If it fails after a route or model change, run
`pnpm gen:api` (also from `web/`) to regenerate
`web/src/api/schema.d.ts`, then re-run `pnpm check:api`.
